headline.line: This study analyzed pedestrian waiting times before crossing in front of autonomous vehicles (AVs) and human-driven vehicles (HDVs) using a random intercepts accelerated failure time survival model.

synthesis.paragraph: In the citation graph, "The vehicle routing problem with cross-docking for perishable products under freshness-life and travel time uncertainties" shares 4 references with the June 29 paper "The multi-commodity vehicle routing problem with temperature requirements", including "Production scheduling and vehicle routing with time windows for perishable food products", "Vehicle routing problem with time-windows for perishable food delivery", and "A vehicle routing algorithm for the distribution of fresh vegetables and similar perishable food". The same paper also shares 3 references with the June 23 paper "Two-stage fleet size and mix electric vehicle routing problem with energy estimation", specifically "Routing a mixed fleet of electric and conventional vehicles", "An Adaptive Large Neighborhood Search Heuristic for the Pickup and Delivery Problem with Time Windows", and "The electric vehicle routing problem with energy consumption uncertainty". Additionally, "ST-KFNet-Based Framework for Online Metro Passenger OD Demand Forecasting under Uncertainty" shares 3 references with the June 25 paper "Bus Passenger Flow Forecast Based on the GRU-Informer Model", which are "Forecasting the short-term metro passenger flow with empirical mode decomposition and neural networks", "Traffic Flow Prediction using Kalman Filtering Technique", and "DeepPF: A deep learning based architecture for metro passenger flow prediction". Over the last 30 days, Hong Kong Polytechnic University appeared on 26 papers, Tongji University appeared on 25 papers, University of Hong Kong appeared on 21 papers, and Tsinghua University appeared on 20 papers.
